conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/dp/hcb/hcf/qcf+hcb/qcb+hcf/qcf,qcf/qcb,qcb/rdp motions preserved. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Charge motions noted, Tekken input keeps the end direction+button. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input. XIV data primary; XV deltas recorded in notes.
game: KOF XIV / KOF XV / KOF: Maximum Impact 1&2
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input

dp+1.name: 100 Shiki Oniyaki
dp+1.notes: dp+A/C, EX OK; present in XIV, XV, MI1/2

hcb+3.name: 212 Shiki Kototsuki In
hcb+3.notes: hcb+B/D, EX OK; dashing elbow into head-slam explosion

hcb,f+3.name: Kuzukaze
hcb,f+3.notes: close hcb,f+B/D, EX OK; side-switch grab, no damage

qcb+1~v2.name: 127 Shiki Aoibana 3
qcb+1~v2.notes: qcb+A/C after Aoibana 2; EX leaping claw; rekka 3 of 3, overhead knockdown

qcb,hcf+1.name: Ura 1018 Shiki Yashiori
qcb,hcf+1.notes: qcb,hcf+A/C; flame barrage; XIV version of the input shared with XV Ya Sakazuki

qcb,hcf+1~xv.name: Ura 108 Shiki Ya Sakazuki
qcb,hcf+1~xv.notes: KOF XV: qcb,hcf+P chargeable; replaces Yashiori on this input in XV

qcf+1.name: 108 Shiki Yami Barai
qcf+1.notes: qcf+A/C, EX OK; ground projectile; XIV and MI1/2 only - REMOVED from Iori in KOF XV

qcf,hcb+1.name: Kin 1211 Shiki Ya Otome (Maiden Masher)
qcf,hcb+1.notes: qcf,hcb+A/C; dash-in flurry of claws into purple flame blast; signature DM, present XIV/XV/MI

qcf,qcf+1.name: Ura 316 Shiki Saika
qcf,qcf+1.notes: 2qcf+A+C during Ya Otome; claw down-up into angled flame pillar

qcf,qcf+3+4.name: Kin 1218 Shiki Yatagarasu
qcf,qcf+3+4.notes: Climax; ground drag into huge claw slash
